title: BusinessService
description: TOGAF-sourced structural archetype — Business Architecture building block. Extends Structure with TOGAF Business Architecture vocabulary: service granularity, business domain, business criticality. Used as archetype_id on Structure Ascriptions representing business services. TOGAF mapping: Business Service (Content Metamodel, Business Architecture domain). Source framework: TOGAF (Business Architecture, Content Framework).

serviceGranularity.description: TOGAF Business Service composition level. ATOMIC = single indivisible service unit. COMPOSITE = aggregation of multiple business services. TOGAF mapping: Business Service granularity (Content Metamodel).

businessDomain.description: Business domain partition (e.g., 'finance', 'hr', 'logistics', 'customer-management'). TOGAF mapping: Business Architecture domain partition.

businessCriticality.description: Business impact classification (descending criticality). Drives SLA, disaster recovery, and investment prioritization. TOGAF mapping: informs Architecture Principles priority and risk assessment.

channel.description: Delivery channels through which the business service is consumed. Design note: may evolve into interaction references when channel-as-structure is modeled. TOGAF mapping: Business Service delivery channel.
